risks: Fixture materialization, controller mappings and independently checked CPU goldens remain outstanding; the proposed cases do not establish executable parity or device qualification.
scores.rationale: Mechanical validation confirms clean application, allowed files and preserved question schema. The patch provides concrete cases for all five repair triggers and cache hits, misses and invalidation, while preserving protected-work rules, CPU certification, accelerator attribution and measurement gates. It makes useful, bounded progress without claiming an API selection or hardware result.

selection_rationale: The sole candidate is mechanically valid, auditable and directly advances the remaining workload specification. No required patch corrections are evident; API selection appropriately remains Open pending implementation, device evidence and operator review.
